item.tib: klu skyobs byams ma'i dkyil chog gdung sel bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces pa'i byams ma klu skyobs kyi chog khrigs gdung sel bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mkhan chen nyi ma'i dbang po nas/ dus mtha'i sems can rnams la klu dang sde brgyad sogs kyis 'tshe ba che bas de nyid la phan pa'i thabs dang / klu mchod kyi yi dam stabs bder shin tu byin rlabs che ba yin pas/ byams ma klu yi 'jigs skyobs ma yi chog khrigs 'di nyin bsgrigs shig gsungs nas/ mgo mjug gi rtsom cha dang*/ mngon rtogs mdun bskyed sogs mdzad nas gnang byung bas/ bka' len gyen bzlog ma nus stabs/ de bzhin rab yid khrag skyag ces pa chu mo phag lo'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig rgyal dang phur ba'i 'grub sbyor nyin/ sgo rigs kyi bla ming rnam rgyal tshul khrims zhes bya bas/ bru chen gong ma'i sgrub gnas bya dur rnam thos ri khrod du bris pas/ bstan dang sems can rnams la phan pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
